title: Common Pitfalls
description: Avoid common pitfalls when using Apollo Client with Next.js SSR, SSG, and hydration.

data.text: Hydration mismatches occur when server-rendered HTML differs from client-rendered HTML. With Apollo Client, this happens when queries return different data on the server vs client. Ensure consistent cache initialization and avoid time-sensitive data in SSR.

data.title: Avoiding hydration mismatches
data.content: Use consistent cache initialization and avoid client-only data in SSR.
